note: One playthrough, no online trophies, no mission replay, free roam after the story. Keep a manual save at the start and end of each chapter (15 save slots). Cheats disable trophies and saving — keep the run cheat-free.

stages.blurb: Play the story and build two habits: scan every new vehicle with the WAiNK app and study new animals through the binoculars. Everything you log now counts toward the 100% checklist later. Do the Chapter 1 balcony meditation with Lucia — it is the run's only possibly missable moment.
tips: After the mission Down to Earth, find Lucia at Jason's house in the morning and take the balcony meditation.
Scan vehicles and study animals from the very first missions.
Save manually at the start and end of each chapter.
stages.title: Chapters 1–2: the story, and the one thing you must not skip

stages.blurb: Keep playing the story and take the optional missions as they appear — several introduce the activities the checklist needs. Yasmani's Chapter 3 jobs give you the Snap Gun for Sneakthief, and the optional Chapter 4 mission That's Where The Money Is… unlocks the eight bank vaults.
tips: Do Yasmani's Chapter 3 jobs for the Snap Gun.
Take That's Where The Money Is… in Chapter 4 to unlock the bank vaults.
Keep scanning vehicles: the checklist wants 200 of 277 base models.
stages.title: Chapters 3–4: the story widens, robberies open up

stages.blurb: Play the last chapter to the finale. The final mission earns the second gold, and the credits return you to free roam with everything still available. Use the story's late missions to knock out the partner and getaway trophies while the action is already there.
tips: Finish Operation Savage Glory, then the final mission.
Try the airport jet, the Rhino tank and the armored truck while you are out in the world.
After the credits, the 100% checklist opens under Progress > Stats > 100% Completion.
stages.title: Chapter 5: finish the story

stages.blurb: Work the checklist's robbery rows first — they pay for everything else. Clear all 39 gang operations, 22 bank jobs, 7 payday loan jobs and 8 bank vaults, and fence the totals the checklist asks for. The money funds the eight garages and the $100,000 of shopping.
tips: Robberies first: they fund the garages and the shopping.
Launder marked bills through Yasmani — he pays the most.
Do 50 challenges on the way; the checklist wants 70.
stages.title: 100% checklist, part 1: robberies and money

stages.blurb: Now the open world: card sets, WAiNK scans, flamingos, underwater discoveries, vehicles and animals, then the races, shooting ranges, drone trials and stunts. Remember the checklist only wants portions — 15 of 18 card sets, 100 of 125 flamingos, 200 of 277 vehicles, 100 of 255 animals — so stop at each target and move on.
tips: Stop at each checklist target; do not hunt everything.
All 42 shooting range golds and all 42 drone time trials are required — no skipping there.
300 stunts for the checklist, 250 for the trophy: the same runs feed both.
stages.title: 100% checklist, part 2: collectibles, races and stunts

stages.blurb: Finish the eight qualifying Strangers & Freaks strands and the five side-character finales, max out Strength for both characters, chase the last profile actions, and try the five unconfirmed triggers — flagging them honestly where the method is still unknown. When the checklist reads 100%, A Long Road pops, and the platinum follows with the last straggler.
tips: Only Kirk, Kyle, Yago and Pilot Pete count toward the eight Strangers & Freaks strands.
Work out with Jason and Lucia together to train both at once.
Check the tracker: the last trophy you earn triggers the platinum.
stages.title: Cleanup: strangers, side finales and the platinum

title: Roadmap to the Platinum
